spans.s: 1. yā́-t, pr. pt. √ yā, moving etc..

2. yā́t, ab. (of rel. yá), ad. cj. (V.) as 🞄far as;
 as long as, while.
ya-tá, pp. (√ yam) restrained etc.: (a)- 🞄gir, a. restraining speech, silent.
yat-anīya, fp. n. imps. one should 🞄strive after (lc.).

ya-tamá, a. (n. -d) who or which of 🞄many (V.);
 -tará, a. (n. -d) which of two (V.).

yata-vāc, a. restraining oneʼs speech, 🞄silent;
 -vrata, a. firm of purpose.
yatá-sruc, a. having an outstretched 🞄ladle (RV.).
yata‿ātman, a. having oneʼs mind 🞄concentrated, controlled oneself.
1. yá-ti, a. pl. (nm. ac. yáti) as many as.

2. yát-i, m. disposer (V.): pl. N. of 🞄an ancient race connected with the Bhṛgus;
 🞄sg. (striver), one who has renounced the world, 🞄ascetic, anchorite.
yati-cāndrāyaṇa, n. kind of 🞄penance.
yat-i-tavya, fp. n. one should 🞄exert oneself, for (lc.).

yati-thá, a. (ī́) the how-manieth (Br.);
 🞄-dhā́, ad. in how many parts or places (AV.).
yat-in, m. ascetic.
yati-bhraṣṭa, pp. lacking the requisite 🞄caesura.
yato-mūla, a. originating in which.

yatna-vat, a. possessed of volition;
 🞄taking trouble, exerting oneself (with lc.).

yatra-kāma‿avasāya, m. 🞄magical power of transferring oneself anywhere 🞄at will;
 -tatra-śaya, a. lying down 🞄anywhere, not minding where one sleeps.
yatra-tya, a. being or dwelling in 🞄which place.
yātayáj-jana, a. marshalling 🞄the people, arousing men to activity (RV.).
yā́-tave, d. inf. to travel.

yā-tavya, fp. to be gone against, — 🞄attacked;
 n. imps. one should go, start, or 🞄march: d. for departure.

yāta‿āyā́ta, n. going and coming;
 🞄ebb and flood.

yā-tú, m. [√ yā: attack], (V.) sorcery;
 🞄kind of fiend: -dhā́na, m., ī, f. kind of 🞄fiend or goblin.
2. yā-tṛ́, m. [pursuer: √ yā], avenger 🞄(RV.¹).
3. yā-tṛ, f. wife of husbandʼs brother.
yātra‿utsava, m. festive train, 🞄procession.
